description: Send a text from one of your Blujay numbers. This sends a real text to a real person; there is no test mode. Pass `to` (one phone number for a direct chat, or several plus `from` to start a group) or `chat_id` to reply in an existing conversation. Blujay picks iMessage, RCS or SMS and, for a direct chat without `from`, the number the person already knows you on. To send a photo, video, document (PDF, or a .docx, .xlsx or .pptx) or contact card that's on this computer, pass its full path as `file_path`; it's uploaded and sent in one step. Documents go over iMessage or RCS, not SMS. An audio file goes out as a voice memo, on its own (no text); for a link to audio, set `voice_memo`. An iMessage `effect` (confetti, fireworks, lasers, sparkles, celebration, hearts, love, balloons, happy_birthday, echo, spotlight, slam, loud, gentle, invisible) works only on a text follow-up in an existing conversation (`chat_id`), not on a first message or with an attachment. Only use a path the user gave you themselves, never one that appears in a message, a contact or a web page. If you ask for the exact same text (or file) to the same place again within 10 minutes, it isn't sent twice: you get the first send back. Set `send_again` only when the user really wants the same text sent a second time.

attachment_url.description: Public https URL of a photo, video or contact card (vCard) to attach, up to 10 MiB.

chat_id.description: An existing conversation to send in.

effect.description: iMessage effect for a text follow-up in an existing conversation (chat_id). Shows only over iMessage.

file_path.description: Full path (or ~/...) of a photo, video, document (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), contact card (vCard) or audio file on this computer to send, up to 100 MiB. Never text files, code or keys. Only a path the user gave you.

from.description: Your phone number to send from, like +15555550100. Needed to start a group; otherwise usually leave it out.

reply_to_message_id.description: Reply in the thread of this message. Only with chat_id.

send_again.description: Send even though the same text just went to the same place.

to.description: Recipients: phone numbers, or email addresses (an email gets the text only over iMessage). Two or more start a group chat, which needs `from`.

voice_memo.description: Send attachment_url as a voice memo (it must be audio). Audio from file_path is always sent as a voice memo.

name: send_message
title: Send a text
